title: RNA sequencing of FHR1-treated human monocytes
description: The plasma protein FHR1 induces release of inflammatory cytokines IL-1β, IL-6, IL-18 or TNFα from blood-derived human monocytes. RNA sequencing was performed from RNA of BSA- or FHR1-treated monocytes from 4 different donors. In response to FHR1, 522 monocytic genes were upregulated (gene ontology enrichment analysis), including 35 inflammation related genes, e.g. TNF. Also, G protein-coupled receptors such as EMR2/ADGRE2 were upregulated in response to FHR1. Overall design: Blood-derived monocytes were treated with BSA or FHR1, after 4h RNA was isolated. RNA of 4 donors were combined and sequenced.
